title: Labeled examples of a restricted function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $[n]$, let $z$ assign signs on $P$, and let $M$ be a natural number. Given an $M$-tuple of assignments on the coordinates outside $P$, produce an $M$-tuple whose $i$th entry consists of that free-coordinate assignment and the value of the target's restriction determined by $P$, $z$, and that assignment.

the input is an $M$-tuple of assignments on coordinates outside $P$
caveat: The definition of the target restriction operation is not included in the payload.
